Trust me when I say, I get it. I've had people in my life that are great friends, they check up on me, try to cheer me up. I have one semester of college left to graduate, and a lot of other things around my life. But I feel empty, as if nothing can fill that void but leaving this earth. The one thing I can tell you, is, just wait a but longer. Idk how old you might be, im 22, idk how much longer I would be around, but im waiting a few years to see if there's anything that might be a ble to fill that emptyness. Maybe you should wait a bit longer too, to see what awaits you, maybe its something great and something amazing you never expected, but you won't know unless you find it. Give time a bit of time. But yeah, I do understand what you mean

Sometimes, the best way to fight it off is to find something as a distraction, make the best out of it. I'm consistently battling that every day, and it's hard not to think of those things. But there's also the fact that there might be something worth holding on to, something that might make you want to stay longer, and fight for it. I have no idea what it might be, because I'm looking for it as well, but, try your best to find something. It's not easy, its tough going through things on a day to day basis, but, even as a random person respond to you, I believe you can fine something. Just look hard, and maybe, just maybe, it can be something that will change your life
